sourceRefs.locator: Opening site description, Middle Kingdom fort with temple of Horus and political changes in the Second Intermediate Period.
Note, location on the west bank and present submergence beneath the reservoir.

summary.de: Befestigte Siedlung am zweiten Nilkatarakt im heutigen Sudan. Der alte Fundort liegt heute unter dem Stausee.
summary.en: Fortified settlement near the second Nile cataract in present-day Sudan. The site now lies beneath the reservoir.
